categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of automotive and other transportation vehicle parts, including plastic and metal components. It also engages in mold manufacturing and trading of electrical machinery and hardware. The business is divided mainly into OEM (original equipment manufacturer) and AM (aftermarket) segments, focusing on automotive plastic parts, metal parts, and other components such as fans and active grille shutters.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including CAD/CAM/CAE for mold design, injection molding, electroplating, painting with water-based coatings, and automated assembly lines. It integrates optical and electronic technologies for smart cockpit and lighting components, and uses vacuum plating for decorative finishes. The production emphasizes lightweight materials, environmental-friendly processes, and automation with IoT for real-time monitoring and efficiency improvements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global automotive OEMs and aftermarket clients, with a strong presence in North America, China, and Taiwan. The company serves major automakers and insurance companies, especially in the US aftermarket segment, where it holds significant market share. It also targets emerging markets in Europe and China, focusing on electric and smart vehicle components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing plants and sales offices in Taiwan, China, and the United States, with major sales markets in North America (especially the US), China, Taiwan, and Europe. It has established a global supply chain and logistics network to support its international customer base.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, manufacturing and supplying automotive parts to OEMs and aftermarket distributors. It is involved in product design, development, manufacturing, quality control, and after-sales service, acting as a key tier supplier to vehicle assemblers and repair markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing lightweight, environmentally friendly, and smart automotive components aligned with trends in electrification and autonomous driving. R&D focuses on integrating optical, electronic, and decorative technologies for smart cockpits and lighting, advancing water-based coatings, and enhancing automation and digitalization in production. The company also emphasizes sustainability, carbon reduction, and circular economy initiatives.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of automotive parts to OEMs and aftermarket customers. The company operates on a combination of order-based production for OEMs and inventory-based production for aftermarket demand, supplemented by long-term contracts and certifications that support stable sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest Taiwanese manufacturer of automotive aftermarket plastic and metal collision parts and a leading OEM supplier in Taiwan. It competes with other Taiwanese automotive parts makers such as TYC and DEPO. Its global certifications and extensive product range provide competitive advantages in quality and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$25.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 7.28% growth over the prior year, with net profit increasing by 46.2%. It maintains a strong financial structure with total assets around NT$38.3 billion and equity of NT$28.2 billion. The company shows steady growth supported by expanding market share and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, certified automotive parts with a broad product portfolio that enables one-stop shopping for customers. It differentiates through advanced R&D capabilities, integration of smart and decorative technologies, environmental sustainability practices, and strong global logistics and customer service. Its leadership in aftermarket parts certifications and commitment to innovation provide competitive edge.
